Kiwix retains the encoding tables, codec state machines and streaming
slice APIs. The fork validates UTF-8 through Rust's core library, reads
unaligned UTF-16 through borrowed byte pairs, and uses checked offsets and
initialized output buffers. The crate forbids unsafe Rust.

The six upstream entry points that write directly into a fixed-length
mutable str are omitted. Callers can decode into a byte slice or append
validated output to a String. The simd-accel feature is accepted as a no-op.
Cargo.toml.orig and the upstream README record upstream configuration.
